title: Career and Professional Development II
description: This course equips students with the knowledge and skills to confidently navigate the job market and transition into their careers. Students will refine their career interests, develop job search strategies, and build essential skills in networking, interviewing, and negotiating job offers. By the end of the course, students will have the confidence and practical insights needed to take the next steps in their professional journey.
prerequisites: One of the following courses; AFE 220, AEC 301, ASC 205, EQM 106, FOR 285, HRT 100; or consent of instructor
